title: ARTIFICIAL AFTER ALL
author: Han Saglam
description: This work is 256 contracts on Ethereum. Each contract holds one seed and one compressed neural network in its own code. A call to artificial() runs the network inside Ethereum and returns a 32×32 grayscale image (1024 bytes). The contract computes the image at call time and stores no image. The address here is one example piece; a factory deployed all 256.

call.note: artificial() — returns a 32×32 image as 1024 pixel bytes (1088 raw bytes with ABI framing)
